name: mluva-launch-video
description: Mluva app intro composed from verified native captures

scripts.render: node script/build-intro.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts MluvaIntro out/mluva-intro.mp4 --concurrency=4
scripts.preview: node script/build-intro.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts MluvaIntroPreview out/mluva-intro-preview.mp4 --scale=0.5 --concurrency=4
scripts.fidelity: node script/build-intro.mjs && node script/render-references.mjs && uv run script/verify-fidelity.py
